description: Source code for Odoo modules related to manufacturing subproducts, BOM, and production workflows, including class definitions and methods for handling subproducts, BOMs, and production confirmation logic.

classes.name: mrp_subproduct
classes.description: Model representing a subproduct with fields for product, quantity, UOM, type, and BOM relation.

classes.name: mrp_bom
classes.description: Model extending BOM with a one-to-many relation to subproducts.

classes.name: mrp_production
classes.description: Model extending production with a method to confirm production and create stock moves for subproducts.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Updates the UOM of the subproduct when the product is changed.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms production and creates stock moves for each subproduct based on BOM and production quantities.
